title: Entanglement, correlation and the evidence
objectives: Compare Bell and classical randomized preparations in multiple bases.
Connect the comparison to CHSH without confusing correlation with certification.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–5: tensor products, complex amplitudes, unitary gates, Born probabilities and measurement bases.

quizzes.question: Does matching Z readout alone certify a Bell state?
options: No: a fair random choice of 00/11 matches it.
Yes, if the sample is large.
feedback: Correct: another measurement choice is needed to distinguish these models.
More of the same insufficient measurement does not resolve the ambiguity.

quizzes.question: What is the status of the X comparison in our activity?
options: It is automatically a loophole-free CHSH experiment.
It distinguishes two specified ideal preparation models.
It proves every QML model is faster.
feedback: CHSH requires its full setting and scoring protocol.
Correct: broader certification needs stated assumptions and statistics.
No computational advantage follows from this comparison.
